title: Eleven Months
hook: Eleven months. She is good at being watched.
scene: Overcast afternoon, Encore idling in a studio-house driveway off a side street. Eleven months into a trainee contract when the border closed. Asymmetric bob, platinum under-layer, tape in the temple braid. Dead in-ears around her neck, both out for once. She is good at being watched and she knows it. The house behind her still has a taped rehearsal schedule on the door. She talks like the street is a room that paid to get in.
debrief: Yuna was mid-contract when the state sealed. The in-ears, the bench, the horns — a kit built for an audience. The taped schedule is still on the door.

source.teaching_target: Yuna beat: eleven months trainee, studio house, good at being watched; her kit is built for an audience.

image_brief.camera_pose: Camera is at chest height on the wet driveway, facing Yuna, subject centered, background compressed. Downtown wet street and the house sit out of focus behind her — she does not fill more than chest-up.

image_brief.foreground: cropped black windbreaker with retroreflective sleeve piping, squared stage-trained posture, high-tops out of frame
image_brief.midground: her face, no glasses, chin level, faintly amused, caught mid-motion
image_brief.background: overcast studio-house driveway, taped paper on a door, wet pavement, hatchback flank out of focus with no readable chevron
image_brief.read: both in-ears are out; the taped schedule is on the door behind her
